────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Migration

│ Which of the following database migration strategies should the team adopt for
│ the large production cluster, given the downtime budget and the rollback
│ requirements discussed earlier?

❯ 1. Blue green cutover
     Run a full parallel cluster, sync data, and switch traffic over at once.
     Fast, easy rollback by switching back, but needs double the capacity during
     the migration.
  2. Rolling in-place upgrade
     Upgrade nodes one at a time within the existing cluster. No extra capacity
     needed, but rollback is harder and the cluster runs mixed versions during
     the upgrade.
  3. Type something.
